## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 390 captures during July 2023. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading activity.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 17 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.4 per cent. These results identify the volume of captures that could not proceed through grading and provide the main image-quality measure for the reporting period.

## Grading

Grading identified 91 referable results. The median lag between image capture and completion of grading was 2. This measure summarises the central turnaround time for the grading process during July 2023.

Together, the activity, image-quality and grading measures describe operational performance at West Gate Eye Clinic for the month. The results should be considered alongside local review of image capture and grading processes, with attention to the ungradable captures and the timeliness of grading.
